name: Sneaky People
overview: Scripture warns against those who act with deceit and rebellion, taking counsel apart from the Lord and adding sin to sin, as seen in Isaiah 30:1. Such sneaky people may profess to know God but deny Him through their disobedient and abominable works, described in Titus 1:16. Believers are encouraged to be wise in what is good and innocent regarding evil, cultivating godly wisdom through prayer as exhorted in James 1:5 and Romans 16:19. Ultimately, the consequences of forsaking the Lord and engaging in hidden wickedness bring correction and reproof, underscoring the call to genuine faith and repentance found in Hebrews 6:1 and Jeremiah 2:19.
